name: logger-demo
description: Producer + drive surface of the logger service: emits one Message per level at load and again on every call to its drive route, so the sinks can be compared with raw output. It is a CONSUMER: no stream of its own.

path.description: Base path of the drive route; the audit route is <path>/audit

loggerName.description: Logger name used when the caller passes none (default: the plugin name)

onLoad.description: Emit one Message per level at apply time
